what_it_does: Increases damage dealt for Barbarian and Crusader; increases Armor for all classes.
formula_for_effect: Damage Multiplier = 1 + (Strength / 100); Armor Bonus = +1 Armor per 1 Strength.
cap_or_soft_cap: Uncapped (scales infinitely via Paragon points and Caldesann's Despair augments).
how_it_stacks: Additive across gear rolls gems Paragon and augments; total is multiplied by % Strength passives and buffs (e.g. Rampage Finery).
notes: Primary attribute for Barbarian and Crusader.

what_it_does: Increases damage dealt for Demon Hunter and Monk; increases Armor for all classes.
formula_for_effect: Damage Multiplier = 1 + (Dexterity / 100); Armor Bonus = +1 Armor per 1 Dexterity.
cap_or_soft_cap: Uncapped (scales infinitely via Paragon points and Caldesann's Despair augments).
how_it_stacks: Additive across gear rolls gems Paragon and augments; total is multiplied by % Dexterity passives and buffs.
notes: Primary attribute for Demon Hunter and Monk. In Patch 2.1.0 Dexterity was changed to grant 1 Armor per point instead of Dodge chance.

what_it_does: Increases damage dealt for Wizard Witch Doctor and Necromancer; increases All Resistance for all classes.
formula_for_effect: Damage Multiplier = 1 + (Intelligence / 100); All Resistance Bonus = +0.1 All Resistance per 1 Intelligence (10 Int = 1 All Res).
cap_or_soft_cap: Uncapped (scales infinitely via Paragon points and Caldesann's Despair augments).
how_it_stacks: Additive across gear rolls gems Paragon and augments; total is multiplied by % Intelligence passives and buffs (e.g. Soul Harvest Gruesome Feast).
notes: Primary attribute for Wizard Witch Doctor and Necromancer.

what_it_does: Increases maximum Life pool.
formula_for_effect: Level 70: +100 Life per 1 Vitality. Sub-70: 10 Life/Vit at lvl 1-35; (Level - 25) at lvl 36-60; (4*Level - 205) at lvl 61-65; (5*Level - 270) at lvl 66-69.
cap_or_soft_cap: Uncapped (scales infinitely via Paragon points and Caldesann's Despair augments).
how_it_stacks: Additive across gear rolls gems Paragon and augments; derived Life is multiplied by (1 + Sum % Life / 100).
notes: Universal defensive attribute for all classes.

what_it_does: Determines the probability that an attack scores a critical hit.
formula_for_effect: Critical Hit Multiplier = 1 + (CHD / 100); Average Hit Multiplier = 1 + (CHC% * CHD%).
cap_or_soft_cap: Soft cap of ~75% on character sheet from gear and Paragon; hard cap is 100% (including monster debuffs and items like Shi Mizu's Haori).
how_it_stacks: Additive across base (5%) gear affixes Paragon (+5%) and passives. Monster debuffs (e.g. Iceblink Corpse Lance Brittle Touch) add directly against the target.
notes: Base CHC is 5%. Damage over Time skills (Rend Haunt) factor (1 + CHC * CHD) directly into every tick rather than rolling crits dynamically.; Numeric columns transcribed from existing formula_for_effect/cap_or_soft_cap/how_it_stacks prose (mitigation: formula); Codex literal audit phase 2 B.

what_it_does: Increases the damage multiplier applied when an attack scores a critical hit.
formula_for_effect: Critical Hit Damage = Non-Crit Damage * (1 + CHD / 100).
cap_or_soft_cap: No hard cap (base is 50%; maximum gear + Paragon total reaches ~480-600%+ depending on dual-wielding and special affixes like The Witching Hour).
how_it_stacks: Additive across base (50%) gear affixes (gloves amulet rings weapon) Paragon (+50%) and Emeralds in weapon sockets (+130% each).
notes: Base CHD is 50%. Certain weapons (Exarian Rabid Strike Starmetal Kukri) roll a special 31-35% CHD primary affix.; Numeric columns transcribed from existing formula_for_effect/cap_or_soft_cap/how_it_stacks prose (mitigation: formula); Codex literal audit phase 2 B.

what_it_does: Increases attacks per second (APS) and reduces skill animation frame durations.
formula_for_effect: Weapon_APS = Base_Weapon_Speed * (1 + Weapon_IAS%); Total_APS = Weapon_APS * (1 + Sheet_IAS% + DualWield_15%).
cap_or_soft_cap: Hard cap of 5.00 attacks per second on the character sheet.
how_it_stacks: Weapon Attack Speed (Weapon_IAS) is local and multiplicative with weapon base speed. Non-weapon Attack Speed (armor jewelry Paragon skills) is additive (Sheet_IAS) and multiplies Weapon_APS. Dual-wielding adds an additive 15% IAS into the sheet bucket.
notes: Skills follow discrete animation breakpoints (frames per attack = ceil(60 / APS)). For most pets sheet APS acts as a separate multiplicative damage multiplier instead of increasing attack rate.; Numeric columns transcribed from existing formula_for_effect/cap_or_soft_cap/how_it_stacks prose (mitigation: formula); Codex literal audit phase 2 B.

what_it_does: Reduces the cooldown recovery time of all active skills.
formula_for_effect: Effective_Cooldown = Base_Cooldown * Product(1 - CDR_i); Total_Sheet_CDR% = (1 - Product(1 - CDR_i)) * 100.
cap_or_soft_cap: No hard cap but subject to diminishing returns due to multiplicative stacking (practical ceiling ~80-85%).
how_it_stacks: Multiplicative (diminishing returns). Each gear roll Diamond in helm Paragon (+10%) and passive skill multiplies the remaining cooldown fraction.
notes: Flat cooldown reducers (In-geom Obsidian Ring of the Zodiac) subtract seconds directly from remaining cooldowns after percentage CDR is applied.

what_it_does: Reduces the resource cost required to cast active skills.
formula_for_effect: Effective_Cost = Base_Cost * Product(1 - RCR_i); Total_Sheet_RCR% = (1 - Product(1 - RCR_i)) * 100.
cap_or_soft_cap: No hard cap but subject to diminishing returns due to multiplicative stacking.
how_it_stacks: Multiplicative (diminishing returns). All gear rolls Topaz in helm Paragon (+10%) and skills multiply remaining resource cost. Class-specific RCR affixes multiply on top.
notes: Captain Crimson's Trimmings 3-piece set bonus grants damage reduction equal to character sheet RCR%.

what_it_does: Grants a fixed 20% chance on hit to deal a percentage of damage dealt to all enemies within 10 yards.
formula_for_effect: Proc Chance = 20% (fixed); Damage Dealt to each enemy in 10 yards = Primary_Hit_Damage * (Area_Damage% / 100).
cap_or_soft_cap: No hard cap (maximum gear + Paragon reaches ~178% with two-handed weapons or 198% with dual-wielding).
how_it_stacks: Additive across gear rolls (shoulders gloves rings amulet weapons offhand) and Paragon (+50%).
notes: Area Damage cannot proc Area Damage (no recursive loops). Cannot trigger Life on Hit or proc coefficients. Certain pets and item procs cannot trigger Area Damage.

what_it_does: Increases damage dealt by skills matching that specific damage element (Physical Fire Cold Lightning Poison Arcane Holy).
formula_for_effect: Damage Multiplier = 1 + (Sum_Elemental_Damage% / 100).
cap_or_soft_cap: Soft cap determined by available item affix slots (typically 20% on bracers 20% on amulet plus specific legendaries up to ~60-120%).
how_it_stacks: Additive within the same element across gear affixes legendaries (Cindercoat Magefist Swamp Land Waders SoJ) and skills. Functions as an independent multiplicative bucket against all other multipliers.
notes: Mask of Jeram (up to 200% pet damage) is additive within the pet elemental damage bucket. Stone of Jordan aligns all elemental bonuses to your highest static bonus.

what_it_does: Reduces damage taken from all 6 elemental damage types (Physical Fire Cold Lightning Poison Arcane/Holy).
formula_for_effect: DR% = Resistance / (Resistance + 5 * Attacker_Level); At level 70: DR% = Resistance / (Resistance + 350).
cap_or_soft_cap: Uncapped (diminishing returns on percentage reduction but constant linear scaling for Effective Health Pool).
how_it_stacks: Additive across gear rolls Diamonds in armor sockets (+78 each) Paragon (+250) passives and +0.1 per point of Intelligence. Secondary single resistance rolls add on top for that specific element.
notes: 1 All Resistance provides the exact same damage mitigation value as 10 Armor (10:1 balance ratio).

what_it_does: Reduces damage taken from all incoming attacks and damage types.
formula_for_effect: DR% = Armor / (Armor + 50 * Attacker_Level); At level 70: DR% = Armor / (Armor + 3500).
cap_or_soft_cap: Uncapped (diminishing returns on percentage reduction but constant linear scaling for Effective Health Pool).
how_it_stacks: Base item armor flat armor rolls Strength (1:1) and Dexterity (1:1) are summed additively then multiplied by (1 + Sum % Armor Bonuses / 100).
notes: Applies universally to physical and all elemental damage types.

what_it_does: Restores a flat amount of Life each time an attack hits an enemy.
formula_for_effect: Life Restored = Sheet_LpH * Skill_Proc_Coefficient (in Patch 2.1+ most attacks restore 100% of LpH once per cast animation on hitting at least one target).
cap_or_soft_cap: Soft cap determined by gear affix rolls (weapons bracers rings amulet helm) and Paragon (+10735).
how_it_stacks: Additive across all equipment rolls and Paragon points.
notes: Does not proc from Area Damage Thorns or passive/secondary item procs.

what_it_does: Restores a flat amount of Life when an enemy is killed by the player.
formula_for_effect: Life Restored = Sheet_LaeK per slain monster.
cap_or_soft_cap: Soft cap determined by secondary affix rolls on gear.
how_it_stacks: Additive across all gear secondary rolls.
notes: Synergizes with Monk passive The Power of Youth and Witch Doctor/Necromancer mechanics.

what_it_does: Continuously restores Life every second (Life per Second / LPS).
formula_for_effect: Total_LPS = (Sum_Flat_LPS + Passive_LPS) * (1 + Sum_%_LPS_Bonuses / 100).
cap_or_soft_cap: Soft cap determined by gear rolls legendary gems and Paragon (+8046).
how_it_stacks: Additive across gear flat rolls Paragon passives and Molten Wildebeest's Gizzard; total is modified by % Life Regeneration buffs.
notes: Active continuously both in and out of combat.

what_it_does: Increases maximum Life pool by a percentage of base and Vitality-derived Life.
formula_for_effect: Total_Max_Life = (Base_Life_from_Level + Total_Vitality * HP_per_Vit) * (1 + Sum_%_Life / 100).
cap_or_soft_cap: Soft cap based on available item affix slots (helm socket up to 23% shoulders/chest/belt/rings/amulet up to 15% each) and Paragon (+25%).
how_it_stacks: Additive across all gear % Life rolls Flawless Royal Amethyst in helm (+23%) Paragon (+25%) and passives.
notes: Directly scales overall character Toughness linearly.

what_it_does: Increases character walking and running velocity.
formula_for_effect: Total_Speed = Base_Run_Speed * (1 + Total_MS% / 100).
cap_or_soft_cap: Hard cap of +25% from gear affixes and Paragon combined. Skills passives and legendary procs can exceed the 25% cap.
how_it_stacks: Gear affixes (up to 12% per item) and Paragon (+0.5% per point max 25%) add together into a hard-capped 25% bucket. Skills passives and legendary procs add outside this cap.
notes: Standard practice is allocating Paragon to reach 25% combined with boots or reaching 25% via Paragon alone.; Numeric columns transcribed from existing formula_for_effect/cap_or_soft_cap/how_it_stacks prose (mitigation: formula); Codex literal audit phase 2 B.

what_it_does: Deals flat physical damage to attackers when struck or applied offensively via specific skills/items (Invoker set Hack).
formula_for_effect: Base_Thorns_Damage = Sheet_Thorns * (1 + Primary_Stat / 100). Real Thorns multiplies by independent debuffs; Converted Thorns uses skill weapon damage %.
cap_or_soft_cap: Uncapped (scales with secondary item rolls Topaz in weapon Boyarsky's Chip Heart of Iron and Paragon).
how_it_stacks: Flat thorns from secondary gear rolls Topaz in weapon (+38000) Boyarsky's Chip and Heart of Iron are summed additively then multiplied by % Thorns passives (Iron Maiden +50% Tough as Nails +25%) then multiplied by (1 + Primary_Stat / 100).
notes: Cannot critically strike (except via Envious Blade). All Thorns damage is Physical except Demon's set bonuses (Fire/Holy).

what_it_does: Increases the drop probability of higher-tier items from monsters and containers.
formula_for_effect: At level 70: +10% of sheet MF applies to Legendary items; +30% to Rare items; +100% to Magic items.
cap_or_soft_cap: Hard cap of 300% from items and fortune shrines.
how_it_stacks: Additive across gear (Topaz in helm Nagelring) and multiplayer party bonus (up to 300%).
notes: Largely obsolete in Reaper of Souls due to 90% penalty to legendary drop rate scaling and massive Torment difficulty drop rate multipliers.; Numeric columns transcribed from existing formula_for_effect/cap_or_soft_cap/how_it_stacks prose (mitigation: formula); Codex literal audit phase 2 B.

what_it_does: Increases the amount of gold dropped by monsters and containers.
formula_for_effect: Total_Gold_Dropped = Base_Gold * (1 + Sheet_GF% / 100) * Difficulty_Multiplier.
cap_or_soft_cap: Sheet items and Paragon capped at 300%. Game difficulty multiplier stacks multiplicatively on top (e.g. Torment 16 grants +7000% multiplicative).
how_it_stacks: Gear affixes Emerald in helm and Paragon (+50%) are additive up to the 300% sheet cap; game difficulty multiplier multiplies the resulting total.
notes: Synergizes with Boon of the Hoarder Goldwrap (converts gold pickup into Armor) and Avarice Band.; Numeric columns transcribed from existing formula_for_effect/cap_or_soft_cap/how_it_stacks prose (mitigation: formula); Codex literal audit phase 2 B.

what_it_does: Increases experience gained from monster kills.
formula_for_effect: At level 70: % XP bonus on gear is penalized by 90% (divided by 10; e.g. +50% Ruby in helm grants +5% effective XP). Flat XP per kill adds directly per slain monster.
cap_or_soft_cap: No hard cap but subjected to 90% effectiveness penalty at level 70 for percentage XP.
how_it_stacks: Flat XP per kill is additive across gear. % XP bonus is additive across gear and gems divided by 10 at level 70 shared equally across the multiplayer party and multiplied by difficulty/Greater Rift multipliers.
notes: Flat XP per kill does not scale with game difficulty and is negligible at level 70.; Numeric columns transcribed from existing formula_for_effect/cap_or_soft_cap/how_it_stacks prose (mitigation: formula); Codex literal audit phase 2 B.
